rows.label: qst650204_msg0001
rows.name: Tora... Looks like you found it, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0002
rows.name:
Will you believe I'm the real Senzou
now, mo?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0004
rows.name: What's wrong, Tora, mo?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0005
rows.name:
Have you forgotten those old days when
all three of us worked on it with such
passion, mo?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0006
rows.name: Of course I haven't, mo!

rows.label: qst650204_msg0007
rows.name: You really are Grandpa Senzou, mo!

rows.label: qst650204_msg0008
rows.name: Mo-mo... Tora!

rows.label: qst650204_msg0009
rows.name: You've grown, Tora, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0010
rows.name: You're taller than me now, mo...

rows.label: qst650204_msg0011
rows.name:
It's all thanks to devouring
Sweet-Sweet Wieners every day, mooo!

rows.label: qst650204_msg0012
rows.name: Those things every day...

rows.label: qst650204_msg0013
rows.name: ...That's enough reminiscing, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0014
rows.name:
There's something we need to do now,
mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0015
rows.name:
Tora, did you have Hana gather the
Blade battle data, mo?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0016
rows.name:
With Boss and the others helping, we
got all of it perfectly, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0017
rows.name: But why do you need battle data, mo?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0018
rows.name: It's for your friends, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0019
rows.name: For Boss and the others...?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0020
rows.name: Hana, come with me for a bit, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0021
rows.name: Master...

rows.label: qst650204_msg0022
rows.name: You can go with him, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0023
rows.name:
Understood, mo. If he tries anything
weird, I'll send him flying, mo.

rows.label: qst650204_msg0024
rows.name: I won't do anything like that, mo!

rows.label: qst650204_msg0025
rows.name: Will Hana really be okay?

rows.label: qst650204_msg0026
rows.name:
I have no idea what he's planning, but
I'll trust Grandpa Senzou, mo...

rows.label: qst650204_msg0027
rows.name:
After seeing that book... I'm
worried...
